## About Meraki Hillside Villa
Meraki Hillside Villa is a private, luxury 4BHK hillside villa situated in Khingar, Panchgani, Maharashtra. Built on a elevated cliffside site overlooking the Panchgani dam and valley, the villa is designed for exclusive private group stays, accommodating up to 16 guests.

---

## Core Property Specifications
- **Property Type**: 4BHK Private Luxury Villa
- **Total Occupancy**: Up to 16 guests (4 spacious bedroom suites)
- **Bedrooms**: 4 air-conditioned bedrooms with King size beds, premium mattresses, and attached private bathrooms.
- **Bathrooms**: 4 en-suite modern bathrooms with hot water geysers and complimentary toiletries.
- **Swimming Pool**: Private cliffside infinity pool with direct views of the Panchgani dam and mountain valley.
- **Dining & Cook Service**: Resident in-house cook available on-site for preparing fresh Veg and Non-Veg home-style meals, authentic Maharashtrian dishes, and live charcoal BBQ.
- **Lawn & Outdoor Area**: Manicured garden lawn with night fairy lights, seating lounge, and outdoor dining deck.
- **Entertainment & Recreation**: Indoor games room featuring a full-size Table Tennis (T.T) table, Foosball, carrom, board games, Smart TV, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- **Parking**: Secure, gated inside parking for 3 to 4 vehicles.
- **Pet Policy**: Pet-friendly property (well-behaved pets welcome with prior host notification).
